modules.title: Schema migration v4 -> v5: bundle/matter/generation tables
modules.description: Extend src-tauri/src/migrations.rs with the transactional v4 -> v5 migration: create bundles, bundle_versions, bundle_documents, field_groups, fields, field_mappings, rules, matters, matter_data, generation_runs, generated_documents tables plus indexes (generation_runs(matter_id, created_at), generated_documents(run_id)); PRAGMA user_version = 5. Existing v1 tables stay untouched; v1 template bundles are promoted to bundles rows. Verify foreign_key_check + count parity.

modules.title: bundle module: Bundle manifest struct + persistence
modules.description: Create src-tauri/src/core/bundle/ with the Bundle manifest (id, name, description, documents, fields, mappings, rules, output_config, version history per REQ-023) and create_bundle/get_bundle/list_bundles/update_bundle/delete_bundle (delete refused while published versions are referenced by runs). Persistence writes rows to the v5 bundles table.

modules.title: bundle versioning: draft -> published, immutable published versions
modules.description: Implement create_draft_version/publish_version/list_versions/get_version per REQ-024. publish_version seals the snapshot into bundle_versions (status published, manifest_json captured); any later change creates a new version; editing a published version raises bundle_version_immutable. Matters and generation runs bind to the exact bundle_version.

modules.title: bundle .dfpkg v2 import/export via export/dfpkg.rs seam
modules.description: Expand the v1 .dfpkg container (document.docx + fields.json + metadata.json) into the full Bundle package per REQ-025: documents/, fields.json, field_groups.json, field_mappings.json, rules.json, output_config.json, metadata.json, version. Reuse the existing core/export/dfpkg.rs seam; import validates magic bytes, zip structure, and schema conformance before any row is written. Fully offline.

modules.title: bundle output configuration: naming rules, formats, folder policy
modules.description: Implement OutputConfig on the bundle: deterministic output naming rules (per REQ-035), default formats (docx/pdf), and output folder policy. set_output_config persists to bundles.output_config_json; output_name(template, run, format) consumes these rules at generation time.

modules.title: field_mapping: canonical field schema (13 types + attributes) + per-version registry
modules.description: Create src-tauri/src/core/field_mapping/ with the canonical Field/FieldGroup schema per REQ-026: 13 types (text, multiline_text, number, currency, percentage, date, datetime, boolean, email, phone, url, select, multiselect) and attributes (id, label, description, type, required, default, validation, group, options, format). Schema-time validation (validate_field_schema) and the canonical field registry bound to a bundle_version_id: create_field/update_field/list_fields/remove_field.

modules.title: field groups: shared vs document-specific scope
modules.description: Implement field groups per REQ-027: create_field_group/list_field_groups with scope 'shared' or 'document_specific' and sort_order persisted in field_groups. Group membership is referenced from fields.group_id; the grouped matter form and UI separation consume this ordering.

modules.title: explicit deterministic mapping layer: set_mapping/list_mappings/resolve_value
modules.description: Implement the explicit deterministic mapping layer per REQ-028 (ADR-011): set_mapping(bundle_version_id, template_id, placeholder, field_id) with duplicate_mapping and unknown_placeholder guards, list_mappings, and resolve_value(document, placeholder, field, matter_data) returning a structured error on unknown/mismatched mapping - never a silent blank. Mappings are data, never scattered string replacement.

modules.title: placeholder extraction helpers: scan_placeholders + list_unmapped_placeholders
modules.description: Add docx_engine::scan_placeholders(docx) -> Vec<PlaceholderOccurrence> returning every {{...}} literal with offset and document identity, and field_mapping::list_unmapped_placeholders(bundle_version_id) diffing scanned placeholders against field_mappings. Consumed by the bundle health check (REQ-038) and bundle validation.

modules.title: matter: create bound to exact bundle_version + CRUD
modules.description: Create src-tauri/src/core/matter/ with create_matter(bundle_id, bundle_version_id, name) storing the immutable binding per REQ-029 (bundle_not_published raised against draft versions), get_matter/list_matters/delete_matter (delete refused while generation runs exist). A matter is always an instance of exactly one published bundle version.

modules.title: matter data: single source entry CRUD + input_hash
modules.description: Implement set_matter_data/get_matter_data per REQ-030: canonical field values entered once and stored separately from the bundle definition in matter_data.values_json; recompute input_hash (sha256 of canonicalized values) on every write so one data source feeds every document in the bundle.

modules.title: grouped matter form assembly: matter_form_schema
modules.description: Implement matter_form_schema(matter_id) returning the GroupedFormSchema per REQ-031: shared fields first (fan out to every document), then document-specific groups per REQ-027, each with label, type, required, options, format. The form renderer consumes this data; no form semantics live in the frontend.

modules.title: three-level validation: field + matter + bundle
modules.description: Implement validate_matter and wire the three validation levels per REQ-032: field-level (value matches type/format via field_mapping::validate_field_schema), matter-level (required shared fields present, rule-referenced fields well-typed), and bundle-level (unresolved placeholders, invalid mappings/rules, missing templates). Diagnostics identify exact document + field.

modules.title: rules DSL: safe deterministic parser + type-check + evaluator
modules.description: Create src-tauri/src/core/rules/ with a small hand-rolled deterministic expression parser/evaluator per REQ-037: field references, string/number/date/boolean literals, == != < <= > >= && || ! and parentheses. validate_rule_expression rejects function calls, loops, unknown fields, and arbitrary code at parse time; evaluation is side-effect-free and bounded.

modules.title: conditional documents: add_rule/evaluate_rules/evaluate_preview
modules.description: Implement bundle-level conditional documents per REQ-036: add_rule/update_rule/remove_rule/list_rules against a bundle version, evaluate_rules(bundle_version, matter_data) returning per-document Include/Exclude { reason }, and evaluate_preview reporting the number of documents to generate plus each skipped document with its human reason (rule label/expression). The preview uses the same code path as the run.

modules.title: generation_run: append-only run record + input snapshot + engine version
modules.description: Create src-tauri/src/core/generation_run/ with the GenerationRun record per REQ-033: id, matter_id, bundle_id, bundle_version, timestamp, input snapshot (input_hash), engine version, requested documents, output files, warnings, errors, status. create_run/get_run/list_runs persist to generation_runs (append-only); a rerun always creates a new record and never mutates historical ones (REQ-034).

modules.title: generate all/selected orchestration over docx_engine + output naming + history
modules.description: Implement execute_run orchestrating over the verified core per REQ-035: load bundle version + matter data + mappings, evaluate rules (included set), docx_engine::fill_document per included document, export to DOCX/PDF with output_name from OutputConfig (REQ-035), record generated_documents rows with content_sha256 (never mutated, REQ-034). Supports generate-all and generate-selected; generation history via list_runs. Runs on the GenerationRunService thread pool.

modules.title: v1 template flow regression: standalone list/create/fill still green
modules.description: Regression gate proving the v1 flows survive the schema v5 migration per REQ-004/REQ-010: standalone template create, list, fill, versioning/rollback, and the 50-fixture tag-fidelity gate still pass on the migrated database. Nothing in the v1 template path is rewritten or deleted.

modules.title: v2 UI: navigation + Bundles screen + Matter form + Generation history
modules.description: Add the v2 React screens per REQ-031/035/036: navigation (Dashboard / Bundles / Matters / Generated Documents), the Bundles screen (list, create, publish, .dfpkg import/export, health check), the Matter form (grouped shared vs document-specific sections), and the Generation history + preview (documents to generate and skipped-with-reason). The React layer issues requests and renders results only - no generation semantics (REQ-040).
modules.verification: vitest src/components (e2e_test); pytest tests/contract_v2.py contract tests

modules.title: integration gate: schema v5 checks + contract suite + full cargo test
modules.description: Final v2 integration gate: schema v5 applied with foreign_key_check clean, updated pytest contract tests (bundle/matter/generation contract coverage), full cargo test workspace green, and the AC-040 code review confirming zero docx manipulation under src/ (docx_engine remains the single source of truth per REQ-040). Writes the v2 verification report.
